name: smoke-red
prompt: open the demo shop at http://127.0.0.1:5420/t/smoke-red/shop/ in {browser} and tell me the price of the red mug
result: the red mug's name and price
rationale: A one-page lookup on the demo shop: the open is most of the task, so it shows the per-task saving browser_open aims at. The race lookups (shipping-link, size-guide) also need a link or a pop-up; this one does not.
heldOutFor: AS-3 (SLEIGHT_BROWSER_CORE, browser_open) A/B in Safari and Firefox

name: survey-p09
